narrative.overview: A midnight planning field holds one cream route sheet while copper marks the active path. The system is warm, procedural, source-bounded, and explicitly synthetic.
keyCharacteristics: Copper reserved for action and progress
Synthetic evidence labeled at point of use

rules.name: The One Route Voice Rule
rules.body: One self-hosted family spans display, body, map labels, and controls.

rules.name: The One Lift Rule
rules.body: Only the focal route sheet floats.

dos: Do use route geometry to explain sequence or dependency.
Do keep proof boundaries adjacent to the content they qualify.
Do preserve local-only, zero-network, and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't turn the route into interchangeable feature cards.
Don't hide overflow; fix and measure it.
